# R3.4 — Context/memory §5c residuals (BL-15 / DF-S1.19-1/-2)

**Ticket:** `docs/tickets/140_R3.4__context-memory-residual.md`
(seq 4 of 11, Round 3, manifest row 140). **Requirement ids:**
`DF-S1.19-1`, `DF-S1.19-2`, `BL-15`; `R-2.4.1`–`R-2.4.5`;
ADR-0356 (new). **Base:** `svitali/harnessharness-r3.3` — the stacked
R3.3 tip (operator merges; mergePolicy: OPERATOR). **Layer:**
fixture-verified — offline/hermetic only; no staging/live claims, no
credentials, no production mutations.

## What

Discharges **DF-S1.19-1**'s six residual producer/wiring members and
**DF-S1.19-2**'s five residual battery cells; closes **BL-15**;
re-verdicts **R-2.4.3** and **R-2.4.4** `PARTIAL → MET`.

**1. Declared consolidation, executed — never invented.** HIR's
`RuleAction` gains `consolidate_memories{scope, cadence, guards,
consolidator, retention?}` (CC8 member-add; landed spellings
unchanged). `rule_from_action` resolves the sealed declaration —
malformed members fail typed. The driver's `consolidation_round`
fires eligible rules at the run's durable boundaries —
`session_start` at open, `idle` at finish, `rate_limit` at both —
through `MemoryPort::consolidate`; an armed rule with no memory
boundary is `UnbackedPort{kind: "consolidate"}`, never a silent skip.

**2. `context.memory.consolidated` — the durable watermark (I-FOLD).**
New audit-grade class: `{rule_id, cadence, trigger, input_watermark,
last_success_watermark, applied[], skipped_*, deferred[], usage,
retention_*}`. The fold carries `last_success_watermark` forward, so
`session_start` never re-fires across a resume — the durable row is
the consolidation state, never a shadow copy.

**3. `MemoryUsage`-fed reclamation on the landed scheduler (CC1).**
A rule's declared `retention` runs R-2.2's `evaluate_retention` over
the memory blob pool; `lifecycle.ledger.tier_transition` rows land
durable before the consolidated row reports `bound`/`reclaimed` (CC3).

**4. `KernelStore::{Local, Remote}` — the coherent mirror.** `Remote`
rides `RemoteStore<Box<dyn StoreChannel>>` over the packaged
`hh-memory-store` `plugin_abi/1` channel; indexes, lifecycle, usage
and stale state all fold the mirror. `forward_read` ships each
indexed read stamp so `memory_usage` agrees on both sides — one stamp
per side. Channel divergence is a typed `ChannelFault`, never guessed
through.

**5. `by_run` + non-`lexical` indexes.** The artifact-layer projection
indexes every `context.memory.written` by run; `by_run{run_id,
classes}` and `structural` queries enumerate it through
`retrieve_indexed`/`structural_index` — one fold source, local or
remote.

**6. Arm-time `ContextPolicy` binding.** `policy_for_variant` binds the
sealed `context_policy` slot's declared variant at open/arm/resume —
an unknown ref refuses typed, never a silent `default` substitution.

**7. Fold `content_ref` rehydration.** `KernelContext::fold` takes the
ledger `Store`; JSON blob → `Structured`, else `Text`; a missing or
unreadable blob leaves an honest skeleton — never fabricated text.
Rebind rows preserve `content_ref`.

**8. `ContextWindowExceeded → stop`.** `AssembledRequest.overflow`
carries `Option<CompactionRequired>`; the driver stops
`context_exhausted{required_tokens, cap}` — the closed spelling on
`control.decision`/`lifecycle.run.finished` — with the overflow
durable on `context.assembled` first. No model call on an overflowed
plan; the kernel-reserved omission item counts toward the
requirement.

**Battery cells (all over the real port):** golden-plan determinism
across repeated assembly over durable `context.observation.recorded`;
a 48-candidate stress with deterministic optional eviction + full
accounting (the reserved `mc-s:omission` excluded from user-candidate
closure); per-slot occupancy projected from the durable
`context.assembled` item rows, reconciled with the plan's table.
